findings.claim: September ranks among the three slowest months of the year for US home sales, with a seller premium of about 9.5 percent versus 13.1 percent in May.
findings.sourceTitle: The Best and Worst Time To Sell A House | Bankrate

findings.claim: After the summer rush the market cools in autumn: fewer listings compete, but the buyers still shopping tend to be serious rather than casual browsers.
findings.sourceTitle: Navigating the Housing Market: A Seasonal Perspective | NAR

findings.claim: September sellers are disproportionately deadline-driven: routines resume after summer and the calendar re-structures, so a fall move is usually tied to a personal deadline rather than idle curiosity.
findings.sourceTitle: The Fall Seller Mindset: Why September Is a Powerful Listing Month

findings.claim: Housing inventory rose 1.6 percent year over year in the final week of August 2026, and in the four weeks ending 23 August new listings hit their highest level since April while total homes for sale reached their highest since May.
findings.sourceTitle: U.S. Housing Market Update: More Listings Meet Slower Demand Heading Into Fall

findings.claim: September 2026 opens with more buyer choice but softer demand, with mortgage rates in the mid-6 percent range and prices still above year-ago levels, so listings compete on presentation rather than scarcity.
findings.sourceTitle: The Fall Market Starts Now: Why September Sets Up the Quarter

findings.claim: NAR's next existing-home sales release, covering August 2026, is scheduled for 10 September 2026.

October is typically the weakest month nationally for sellers, with a seller premium near 8.8 percent, which puts a practical ceiling on how long a September listing can wait before pricing pressure sets in.
findings.sourceTitle: When is the best time to sell a house? | Opendoor Guides

findings.claim: Homes listed in early November have roughly a 20 percent higher chance of selling quickly than those listed in late December, making September to November the last practical window for a year-end close.
findings.sourceTitle: When is the best time to sell a house? | Opendoor Guides

findings.claim: Autumn buyers frequently face hard deadlines such as job relocations, lease expirations and tax-year concerns that require closing before 31 December, including mortgage-interest and property-tax deductions.
findings.sourceTitle: Motivated Sellers Strategies to Close Before Year-End Deadlines

findings.claim: Holiday-season transactions run slower: inspections that take 10 days the rest of the year stretch to 14 to 21 days for November and December closings as underwriters and appraisers take time off.
findings.sourceTitle: The Last Deal Of 2025: What It Takes To Close During The Holidays | Inman

findings.claim: Fall staging guidance is to swap bright summer decor for burnt orange, golden yellow, deep red and earthy brown, introduced through throw pillows, blankets, rugs and accent pieces rather than repainting.
findings.sourceTitle: Cozy and Inviting: Fall Home Staging Tips That Sell | Century 21 Redwood

findings.claim: Autumn staging leans on warmth signals: layered rugs on hardwood, blankets draped over seating, a fireplace stacked with logs, and soft table and floor lamps with warm bulbs instead of overhead lighting, because daylight hours shorten and showings run into the evening.
findings.sourceTitle: Embracing Autumn: Fall Home Staging Tips | William Pitt Sotheby's Realty

findings.claim: Autumn 2026 interior trends centre on rich earth-inspired palettes of terracotta, cinnamon, olive green and mocha, used to add warmth without overwhelming a room.
findings.sourceTitle: 5 Autumn Interior Design Trends to Transform Your Home in 2026

findings.claim: Benjamin Moore's 2026 autumn-winter trend release comprises three lookbooks built on autumnal hues, with the first, 'Analogue', keyed to a reading-nook or home-library mood using heritage black and warm white; its Color Trends 2026 palette names Silhouette AF-655 as Color of the Year alongside Raindance 1572, Swiss Coffee OC-45, First Crush CSP-310, Batik AF-610, Narragansett Green HC-157, Southwest Pottery 048 and Sherwood Tan 1054.
findings.sourceTitle: Benjamin Moore's 2026 Autumn-Winter Trend Color Palette | Homes and Gardens

findings.claim: The dominant 2026 interior palette directions are warm earth tones (clay, terracotta, rust), emotional neutrals (mushroom, oat, warm greige), nature-led greens (sage, eucalyptus, olive), deep blues (denim, indigo, slate), muted pastels and architectural darks (charcoal, soft black).
findings.sourceTitle: Interior Color Trends and Palettes 2026 | SampleBoard

findings.claim: Brown is the most influential colour of 2026, spanning soft cocoa to deep chocolate, with caramel emerging as a warm 1960s-referencing shade and emerald and teal adding depth to otherwise restrained palettes.

Dorm and student-apartment decorating advice is to start planning about two months before move-in, fix a colour scheme and measurements first, then buy large items down to accents, finishing during move-in week.
findings.sourceTitle: Dorm Design Tips: 25+ Ways to Make Your Room Feel Like Home | BU Today

findings.claim: Student furniture rental exists specifically so dorm and college-apartment occupants can furnish a unit for a term without buying, a recurring late-August to September demand spike.
